feeds.title: Dyslexia the Gift Blog
feeds.description: This blog shares information and commentary about issues related to dyslexia and learning. Davis Dyslexia Association International (DDAI) was formed in 1995 by Ronald Dell Davis and his associates in the wake of the success of Davis' book, The Gift of Dyslexia. Our goals are to increase worldwide awareness of dyslexia.

feeds.title: Dyslexic Advantage
feeds.description: Dyslexic Advantage shares resources & articles for dyslexia, dyslexic advantages, learning strategies and tips, help for dyslexia, dysgraphia, dyscalculia, and more. Dyslexic Advantage is a non-profit charitable organization that seeks to transform the way dyslexia is understood by discovery, describing, and publicizing the essential strengths of the dyslexic mind.

feeds.title: Homeschooling with Dyslexia Blog
feeds.description: Homeschooling with Dyslexia Blog is a valuable resource for parents who have chosen to homeschool their children with dyslexia. The blog offers practical tips, curriculum recommendations, and insights into creating a supportive learning environment for dyslexic students at home. It aims to empower parents with the knowledge and tools they need to effectively educate and support their dyslexic children.

feeds.title: Lexercise Blog
feeds.description: Dyslexia and other learning disabilities impact 1 in 5 children. Unfortunately, most schools lack the resources to help these students, & parents struggle to find effective yet convenient treatment. Lexercise was founded in 2008 to solve these problems. We combine the latest in technology with the Structured Literacy approach, which has been validated by decades of research.

feeds.title: OlivehickmottFully Blog
feeds.description: I'm Olive Hickmott. I am a learning coach, trainer and author, working with adults, school staff and children with learning difficulties, to accelerate learning by mental imagery.

feeds.title: Kobi Blog
feeds.description: Kobi is a dyslexia-friendly iOS & Android app, designed to help your child learn to read faster. It is carefully crafted for children who experience reading difficulties.

feeds.title: Luqman's Dyslexia Blog
feeds.description: A blog on dyslexia. I'm Luqman. I have been successfully teaching dyslexic children for more than 15 years.

feeds.title: Smart Kids with Learning Disabilities Blog
feeds.description: This blog educates, guides and inspires families of children with learning disabilities or ADHD -- and to change the perception of learning disabilities as a stigmatizing condition.

feeds.title: The Dyslexia Classroom Blog
feeds.description: Hey there! Welcome to The Dyslexia Classroom Blog. I'm Casey! A Certified Academic Language Therapist, Dyslexia Therapist, and creator of The Dyslexia Classroom. It is my passion to help educators and parents understand their dyslexic learners to help them reach their fullest potential.

feeds.title: Bright Solutions for Dyslexia
feeds.description: Susan Barton is recognized internationally as an expert in the field of dyslexia. Through this blog, she shares dyslexia stories and research-based information in a parent-friendly manner.

feeds.title: Teach My Kid To Read Blog
feeds.description: Supporting teachers so they can teach kids with reading issues the way they need to learn. Passionate about running, and mildly opposed to treadmills.

feeds.title: Learning Lab Blog
feeds.description: Learning Lab programs include academic interventions for children with ADHD, dyslexia, and other learning challenges. We help kids learn in the ways and places that they're comfortable, even if that means not sitting behind a desk. Our blog features Dyslexia tutors and ADHD tutors can help make sure that your child is taken care of.

feeds.title: The Written Word
feeds.description: The Written Word is a dyslexia-focused center dedicated to educating and supporting students, parents, and teachers within the surrounding local communities. Check out our Dyslexia blog for the latest information, news, resources, training, & more.

feeds.title: Dyslexia Ireland Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1972, the Dyslexia Association of Ireland (DAI) is a charity that works with and for people affected by dyslexia, by providing information, offering appropriate support services, engaging in advocacy, and raising awareness of dyslexia. Our vision is a dyslexia-friendly society, where everyone with dyslexia is enabled to fulfill their potential.

feeds.title: The Shut-Down Learner
feeds.description: Dr. Selznick has over six years of blogs talking about dyslexia, learning disabilities, school problems, special education and whatever strikes his fancy.

feeds.title: Dyslexia Assist - By Parents and Children Blog
feeds.description: Dyslexia Assist is a small charity started by parents with dyslexic children to share information, tips, ideas and experiences and tutors. Find parent blogs sharing advice and experience of helping children with dyslexia, also find ideas so children can help each other, share your experience too.

feeds.title: Reading Success Plus Blog
feeds.description: Reading Success Plus blog shares additional articles and information on Dyslexia. Reading Success Plus teaches to struggling readers and dyslexics to read using proven Orton-Gillingham & Lindamood-Bell programs.

feeds.title: Dyslexia Reading Connection, Inc.
feeds.description: Dyslexia Reading Connection is a nonprofit corporation devoted to helping students and adults who have dyslexia. We provide tutoring & screening services specifically geared for students with dyslexia in Northeast Wisconsin.

feeds.title: British Dyslexia Association
feeds.description: The British Dyslexia Association is the voice for the 10% of the population that are dyslexic. We aim to influence government to promote a dyslexia friendly society, that enables dyslexic people of all ages to reach their full potential.

feeds.title: Sydney Dyslexia Blog
feeds.description: I'm Barbara Hoi, founder of Sydney Dyslexia. I know navigating through dyslexia can be overwhelming. Having been through this journey myself with my son nearly 17 years ago, I turned my attention to learning everything possible about dyslexia. I want to transform the misconception that dyslexia is a learning disability. With over 15 years of experience in helping correct dyslexia in adults and children, our blog covers content on dyslexia, other learning challenges, education, and more!

feeds.title: International Dyslexia Association Oregon Blog
feeds.description: The International Dyslexia Association is an international organization that concerns itself with the complex issues of dyslexia. Our mission is to raise awareness and understanding of dyslexia, promote effective intervention strategies, and support individuals with dyslexia, their families, and professionals in our community.

feeds.title: Dyslexia A2Z Blog
feeds.description: Maria Chivers is the founder of Dyslexia A2Z. She is an international author on dyslexia and other learning difficulties. Read articles on Dyslexia, Dyscalculia, Dysgraphia, Dyspraxia, ADHD, and other learning difficulties.

feeds.title: Codebreakers Blog
feeds.description: CodeBreakers has become an in-depth screening and teaching practice that is accessible to both schools and individuals. It is primarily a tuition service that can also train organisations/groups on awareness of dyslexia and train school staff to deliver an effective dyslexia programme. Keep up to date with all things Codebreakers, read our blog posts and discover more about dyslexia and how we can help boost your spelling and literacy.

feeds.title: Decoding Dyslexia CA Blog
feeds.description: Decoding Dyslexia CA is a grassroots movement driven by California families, educators and professionals who recognize the need for conversations with our school districts and policy makers regarding dyslexia. We strive to raise dyslexia awareness, empower families to support their children, and improve resources for students with dyslexia in California public schools.

feeds.title: Touch-type Read and Spell
feeds.description: TTRS is an award winning, online touch-typing course which also helps with reading and spelling skills. TTRS is also suitable for those with dyslexia and other learning difficulties.

feeds.title: Pride Reading Program
feeds.description: Pride Reading Program will help your child with their reading comprehension and dyslexia troubles.

feeds.title: Dyslexia Scotland
feeds.description: A blog about dyslexia from the Scottish perspective. Articles cover Dyslexia Scotland News, Personal Stories, Work & Careers, Wellbeing, Learning, International Perspectives, and more.

feeds.title: Licensed Dyslexia Therapist Blog
feeds.description: It is the mission of Dyslexia On Demand to make dyslexia therapy accessible to students despite geographical limitations or shortages of qualified interventionists. Dyslexia On Demand provides online, virtual, multisensory academic language therapy to students pre-k to adult. Keep up with their latest articles, news, and videos.

feeds.title: Dyslexia Octopus Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Beth. Seven years ago, when I discovered my son had dyslexia, I had a 'light-bulb' moment and understood this explained many of my own difficulties. Ever since I've been on a mission to discover the best ways to wrestle with what I like to call the dyslexia octopus.

feeds.title: Positive Dyslexia
feeds.description: Positive Dyslexia is helping children and adults to overcome their learning challenges like struggle with reading, writing, math, comprehension, learning and paying attention.

feeds.title: DCD - Dyslexia
feeds.description: This Blog shares Information about specific learning needs and ways forward. DCD - Dyslexia works with children and adults in the area of Educational support.

feeds.title: omoguru
feeds.description: Reading tools for dyslexics that improve reading skills in an enjoyable way. Follow to get updates.

feeds.title: Love your Brain
feeds.description: Follow this blog for information, tips, specialized coaching in reading, writing, spelling, mathematics, working memory and organizational skills.

feeds.title: Simple Words Books Blog
feeds.description: Fun 'big-kid' books for struggling readers, early readers and kids with dyslexia. Dyslexic children love our books with low vocabulary high interest engaging stories. We believe the right book gives dyslexic child the opportunity to experience a love of reading and enjoy a chapter book, without tears.

feeds.title: Dyslexia Daily Blog
feeds.description: Dyslexia Daily Blog shares new solutions ideas and treatments to get your child reading and enjoy going to school.

feeds.title: The Codpast Fresh content for students and adults with dyslexia
feeds.description: The Codpast is a groundbreaking interview based talk show where ordinary people share events from their extraordinary lives; getting to grips with and tackling the issues that others shy away from. We put out videos, podcasts & blog articles regularly. It is a media portal and great resource for Adults and University Students whom are preparing themselves for working life.

feeds.title: Dyslexia Tutor
feeds.description: Dyslexia Tutor shares news, resources and other matters on Dyslexia.

feeds.title: Dekker Delves into Dyslexia
feeds.description: Evidenced based literacy instruction for every child in every classroom.

feeds.title: Dyslexia Intervention Services Blog
feeds.description: Christina has a Diploma in Disability Studies and is a licensed Davis Facilitator.This page is set up to create more awareness about dyslexia and to help you understand what dyslexia is and how the problem develops.

feeds.title: The Dyslexia Initiative Blog
feeds.description: The core purpose of The Dyslexia Initiative is to support families, dyslexic children & adults. Our mission is to end the hopelessness that comes with the journey of dyslexia and other learning disabilities. Whether at the beginning of the journey or somewhere on the lifelong path, we aim to be a resource and a tool for information and empowerment.

feeds.title: Ascend Smarter Intervention Blog
feeds.description: Ascend Learning blog help students and parents of students struggling with specific learning disabilities through providing tips and tricks that are popular from our Smart ALEC Resources.

feeds.title: Learning Success Blog
feeds.description: The Learning Success System is a simple method parents can use to help children overcome learning difficulties. It simplifies the process and enables a parent to work at home with their child.

feeds.title: Sydney Dyslexia Blog
feeds.description: Sydney Dyslexia blog gives information about a unique educational program dedicated to those struggling with learning or focusing; to attain the skills, confidence and motivation needed to achieve goals who are having dyslexia.

feeds.title: Orton Gillingham Online Academy Blog
feeds.description: The Orton Gillingham Online Academy is thrilled to bring to you a virtual education site that offers you resources to assist you with teaching those with Specific Language Disability (Dyslexia). We are dedicated and committed to present to you tools that will enhance the teaching/learning venue.

feeds.title: Dyslexia Association of Singapore Blog
feeds.description: The one-stop center for information on Dyslexia and other learning differences in Singapore. Dyslexia Association of Singapore (DAS) is today a vibrant social service organisation with over 250 full-time staff who provide a wide array of services for individuals with dyslexia not only in Singapore but in the region.

feeds.title: Dybuster Blog
feeds.description: This blog is focusing on learning disabilities and provides information and resources for those interested in dsylexia and dyscalculia. Dybuster develops learning software to aid children with dyslexia and dyscalculia.

feeds.title: Dear Dyslexic Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Dear Dyslexic Foundation is the leading organization in Australia for changing the world of dyslexics through storytelling. We empower young people and adults with learning disabilities to reach their full potential. We give young people and adults a platform to share their lived experiences of dyslexia and other learning disabilities.
